title: Arunachal Cong leaders meet Kharge, apprise him of border concerns, opposition to Siang project

ai.summary: Arunachal Pradesh Congress leaders met Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge to discuss border security concerns in Taksing and opposition to a proposed 11,200-MW hydropower project in Siang region, demanding withdrawal of the project and protection for affected communities.

facts.claim: Arunachal Pradesh Congress Committee president Bosiram Siram apprised party chief Mallikarjun Kharge of emerging border concerns at Taksing in Upper Subansiri district and current law and order situation over protests against a proposed 11,200-MW hydropower project in the Siang region
facts.quote: Itanagar, Nov 3 (PTI): The Arunachal Pradesh Congress Committee on Tuesday said its president Bosiram Siram apprised party chief Mallikarjun Kharge of the emerging border concerns at Taksing in Upper Subansiri district and the current law and order situation over protests against a proposed 11,200-MW hydropower project in the Siang region.

facts.claim: The proposed hydropower project is among India’s largest planned hydropower projects
facts.quote: The 11,200-MW hydropower project, proposed on the Siang River, is among India’s largest planned hydropower projects.

facts.claim: The project has triggered apprehensions among local communities over possible displacement, submergence of ancestral land, loss of livelihoods and environmental consequences
facts.quote: However, the project has triggered apprehensions among local communities over possible displacement, submergence of ancestral land, loss of livelihoods and environmental consequences.

facts.claim: The state Congress demanded a joint all-party parliamentary and political delegation visit sensitive border locations to assess the ground situation
facts.quote: The state Congress demanded a joint all-party parliamentary and political delegation visit sensitive border locations to assess the ground situation.

facts.claim: The APCC demanded the withdrawal of additional paramilitary and security forces deployed in SUMP-affected areas and permanent cancellation of the proposed mega dam
facts.quote: The APCC demanded the withdrawal of additional paramilitary and security forces deployed in SUMP-affected areas and permanent cancellation of the proposed mega dam.

ai.background_note: Arunachal Pradesh Congress has raised concerns about border security in Taksing and opposition to a proposed 11,200-MW hydropower project in Siang region, demanding withdrawal of the project and protection for affected communities.
